title: KIT local feedback: localized edit runs the targeted subset, not the whole corpus
scope: KIT ONLY; outcome 2 only; #1321 stays OPEN; no end-to-end dev-cycle % and no child-product claim

environment.note: owner's self-hosted CI runners share this host; benchmark used raw pytest (not check-full) to avoid the host-slot guard, and recorded slot cleanliness before each run

what_is_now_selected_plan_only.note: all leaves share a 133-file floor: 36 conservative dynamic consumers are always added, so even a leaf pulls heavy integration tests — this caps the wall-time win

wall_time_abba.design: same tree, same marker ('not nightly and not release_gate and not slow'); only which tests run differs; 1 warmup per condition then ABBA, n=6 per condition

not_proven_and_contamination: Host under load: owner's self-hosted runners were active during the window (slot-waits of 60/120/180s logged; one AFTER spike to 702.7s under contention). Median is robust to the single spike but ranges are wide — a loaded developer machine, not an isolated bench.

One BEFORE run had 1 pre-existing flaky failure (1 failed, 9246 passed). This slice's diff is docs/evidence ONLY (no code touched), so the failure cannot be caused by it; wall time retained in raw rows.

slow excluded from BOTH conditions for marker-consistency and tractability; the real old full fallback (check-full.sh --pr) INCLUDED slow, so BEFORE here is a conservative lower bound of the old wall.
Not measured: cold OS cache, CI queue/dispatch, paid CPU-minutes, p95 (n too small). No end-to-end development-cycle % claimed.

same_edit_escalates_to_full_at_merge_and.enforcement: verification_tiers.decide_tier (merge/release and ALWAYS_FULL_PATTERNS -> full); impact_check_cli.main sets full_argv=['bash','scripts/check-full.sh', ...] (release -> full profile, else --pr)

no_gate_lowered.nothing_disabled: This slice adds only docs + evidence; no new skip/xfail, no lowered coverage/security floors, no marker edits.

files.wall-time-abba.json: raw wall/cpu per run, medians, ranges, SHAs, versions, host-slot cleanliness
files.plan-and-environment.json: plan-only tiers for leaf/central and escalation to full at merge/release; environment
files.benchmark.py.txt: ABBA wall-time harness (run a copy outside the repo; ROOT path is local)
